name: Adaptive AI Traffic Signal & Corridor Synchronization
description: Deploy adaptive radar/camera signal controllers at key arterial intersections to cut congestion and idling emissions across Telangana urban corridors.

name: Urban Micro-Forests & Cool Roof Mandate
description: Establish Miyawaki micro-forests along ring roads and mandate high-albedo cool roofs on commercial/governmental buildings to combat UHI.

name: Mission Bhagiratha Urban Smart Water Grid & Leakage Telemetry
description: Install ultrasonic flow sensors and pressure monitoring across municipal distribution networks to cut non-revenue water and equalize supply duration.

name: TSRTC Electric Feeder Bus Fleet & Micro-Mobility Corridors
description: Introduce 300 electric mini-feeders connecting metro/transit hubs with suburban residential nodes in Hyderabad, Warangal, and Nizamabad.

name: Basti Dawakhana & Mobile Diagnostic Tele-Clinics Expansion
description: Establish 120 new neighborhood urban primary clinics with real-time digital telemedicine access to major teaching hospitals.

name: Industrial Effluent & Dust Suppression Scrubbers Network
description: Deploy automated mist-cannons, continuous ambient PM sensors, and centralized effluent monitoring across industrial zones (Patancheru, Ramagundam, Kothagudem).

name: Sponge City Permeable Pavements & Lake Interlinking
description: Construct permeable road shoulders, bio-swales, and restore cascading chain-tank storm drainage to eliminate monsoon flash-flood stagnation.

name: Municipal Solid Waste Automated Segregation & Bio-CNG Plant
description: Commission state-of-the-art decentralized waste-to-energy and bio-CNG generation facilities reducing landfill leaching.
